statement_en: If $C_1,\ldots,C_n$ are circles in $\mathbb{R}^2$ with radii $r_1,\ldots,r_n$ such that no line disjoint from all the circles divides them into two non-empty sets then the circles can be covered by a circle of radius $r=\sum r_i$.
